name: Kaidi Sahay Yojana
_eligibility_text: - Applicant must be a family member of a prisoner currently serving sentence in a state jail in Gujarat. - The prisoner should be the sole or main earner of the family. - The prisoner's family must be economically dependent on the prisoner. - The total family income should not exceed ₹1,50,000/- per annum. - The family should not be fragmented (i.e., should be living together and dependent on the prisoner).
